programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: The Hands Of Time
programme.desc: Master Wu mistakenly tries to single-handedly complete a battle he began decades ago against Acronix, one of the twin Hands of Time. But the arrival of the first Time Blade – a weapon with the power to speed up time – sends the Ninja to the Monastery just in time to rescue their master from certain doom.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: The Ninja learn more about the Krux and Acronix – the two fallen Elemental Masters known as the Hands of Time – and are sure that this threat has finally been eliminated. But with Wu out of action and suffering from the effects of the Time Punch, the Ninja discover a new enemy in their midst: The Vermillion Warriors. And the Ninjas have no idea who controls them...

programme.title: A Time Of Traitors
programme.desc: Kai's investigation of a Vermillion Warrior Helmet leads him to discover that Krux is alive and well in Ninjago, living under an assumed identity. Meanwhile, as the Vermillion Warriors go on a kidnapping spree, Lloyd struggles with his role as master-in-training and Nya does her best to reboot Zane, who was knocked off line in his first battle with the Vermillion.

programme.title: The Mask Of Deception
programme.desc: When an unknown criminal syndicate threatens the Royal Family, the Ninja are called back into action and must protect the royal princess and a fabled artifact that may hold supernatural powers. The ninja find themselves scattered to the four corners of the kingdom. Cole and Jay are searching in vain for some sign of Master Wu. Nya fights injustice in the north, while Kai and Zane attempt to fend off an angry lava beast in the west. This leaves Lloyd alone in Ninjago City. He rushes to the scene of a heist at Borg Tower and finds himself up against a team of highly trained operatives led by the mysterious masked MISTER-E. Lloyd fails to prevent the heist and an ancient artifact, the MASK OF DECEPTION, is stolen. Lloyd apprehends one of the criminals but the others escape. Dismayed by his failure, Lloyd calls the ninjas back to Ninjago. The friends are reunited and hope for a little rest and relaxation. These hopes are dashed with the arrival MASTER HUTCHINS, a servant of the Royal Family of Ninjago, who has been sent by the EMPEROR to request their help. A new criminal gang, SONS OF GARMADON (SOG), is attempting to acquire three ancient masks called the ONI MASKS, which are rumored to possess supernatural powers.

programme.title: The Gray Knight
programme.desc: Using his Stone to Life magic the Cloud of Monstrox turns Clay into a living, fighting, breathing stone fighting knight. But will Clay use his forces to fight for good or for evil? Does he have a choice? The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro are able to unlock the forbidden Power Shocking Scare and unleash an attack on the village of Bravington. Knights in their new vehicles rush to the rescue and are able to defeat him with a new Combo Power. In the heat of the battle, the Cloud of Monstrox sees the stone statue of Clay and zaps him to life! Clay is now turned, and is fighting against his friends. It is impossible for them to defeat him without destroying him for good. The Cloud urges Clay on. He attacks the Fortrex in order to get to Merlok. Robin in his Black Knight Mech is trying to stop him, but to no avail. Merlok 2.0 is left undefended. At the very last moment Merlok 2.0 unleashes a blasting spell that sends Clay far far away.

But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Crooner Smurf: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Baby Smurf Is Missing: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Smurfing Out Of Time: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Greedy And The Porridge Pot: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: Smurf Box Derby
programme.desc: Handy Smurf makes another invention: the Smurfmobile. Each Smurf has his – or her – customized vehicle and all, or almost all, the Smurfs enjoy a little spin... But then the evil wizard Gargamel gets hold of the idea and starts making trouble for the Smurfs...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Noble Stag: His wicked cousin, Malcolm the Mean, who plans to kill him and mount him in his trophy room, has turned King Gerard into a black stag. The little Smurfs help their friend. When King Gerard is transformed back into his human form, Malcolm becomes imprisoned in the body of the stag.

programme.title: The Rabbids are on a mission.
programme.desc: Two rabbids play a bowling game using penguins as bowling pins.

programme.title: The Rabbids are lost
programme.desc: A rabbid who got talent after having inhaled the air from a balloon, is suddenly destined to become a star!

programme.title: The Rabbids are too cold.
programme.desc: An old lady distracts a Rabbid, and he accidentally shuts himself inside a supermarket freezer.

programme.title: Super Rabbids to the rescue
programme.desc: Beware ! The three rabbids with super powers have the worst plan to get to the moon!

programme.title: The Rabbids are lost
programme.desc: A rabbid who got talent after having inhaled the air from a balloon, is suddenly destined to become a star!

programme.title: Revenge of the Rabbids.
programme.desc: Blasted into the Polar Regions when his secret HQ explodes, Evil Rabbid raises a penguin army!

programme.title: The Rabbids VS The Animals.
programme.desc: In the country, two Rabbids become fascinated by a fly.

programme.title: The Rabbids are escaping!
programme.desc: John the scientist is trapped inside a rabbid's body, and gets thrown into the junkyard.

programme.title: Rabbid Hibernation and the time machine.
programme.desc: After it breaks down in the middle of the desert, Hibernation Rabbid's Machine is stolen by the rabbids.

programme.title: The Rabbids meet the Cro-Magnons.
programme.desc: Mama Cro-Magnon is on the brink of inventing the wheel when the Rabbids decide to interfere.

programme.title: Super Rabbids to the rescue
programme.desc: Beware ! The three rabbids with super powers have the worst plan to get to the moon!

programme.title: Revenge of the Rabbids.
programme.desc: Blasted into the Polar Regions when his secret HQ explodes, Evil Rabbid raises a penguin army!

programme.title: The Rabbids are causing a stir
programme.desc: Two Rabbids fall asleep on an abandoned couch.

programme.title: When a Pig Flies
programme.desc: Rosie has lost her peace because of such appetizing and ripe acorns growing right above her little snout. To get the desired but inaccessible delicacy, she must jump above her head or simply learn how to fly. It's good there is Masha around, who knows for sure it is always useful to dream.

programme.title: Hold Your Breath
programme.desc: Bright summer day. Bear, while gathering berries, meets female bear in the forest and arranges a date with her. Returning home, he starts cleaning the house and baking a pie. Once the pie is done, the Bear decorates it with strawberries. Masha eats them before starting to hiccup. The Bear tries all manner of remedies from a medical encyclo-pedia to stop the hiccups. In the end, hiccups spread to everyone including all other forest in-habitants.

programme.title: The Grand Piano Lesson
programme.desc: The bear finds a beautiful black piano in the forest. He happily takes it home, fixes and tunes it and begins to play some music. Masha couldn't help staying away from this lovely instrument. She decides to become a world famous pianist, she asks the Bear to teach her how to play the piano.

programme.title: Two Much
programme.desc: Masha has a sister named Dasha. Once upon a time Dasha decides to visit her sister. Even though they look very much alike, they are so different! Unlike Masha, Dasha is a strict and responsible girl. Masha cannot wait to tell the Bear about the news and she takes Dasha with her to pay him a visit. That's where the story becomes even more interesting....

programme.title: Tracks Of Unknown Animals
programme.desc: First snow falls and the Bear decides to teach Ma-sha how to distinguish the tracks of different ani-mals. Masha is quite far from being a good student and brings the poor Bear almost to madness. But to his great surprise it turns out that some of her answers were not as absurd as they seemed.

programme.title: Sabre-Toothed Bear
programme.desc: Everyone is curious to know more details about their ancestors: what they were like, what did they do… Once upon a time the Bear took an interest in how his progenitor Bear could look like. In order to answer this question the Bear has to invent and build…guess what? - a real time machine! And, of course, Masha could not miss such a discovery!

programme.title: What's Inside?
programme.desc: In this episode, Masha decides to figure out how the objects surrounding her are arranged. And in the company of an old friend, this research becomes an adventure. ""What is inside such seemingly simple objects surrounding us? How are the mechanisms that we use every day arranged? Maybe they work with the help of magic? Or maybe each system has a certain order?

programme.title: The First Swallow
programme.desc: Do you know what ornithology is? This is a science that studies birds! Andit is also Dasha's new hobby. She comes to visit Masha and the Bear and discovers a new unique bird species! What is this amazing unusual bird? Hurry up and watch this new episode to find out!

programme.title: Holiday On Ice
programme.desc: Masha wants to learn ice skating. But there's no-body around to teach her because the Bear had fallen asleep. However this does not confuse Ma-sha at all. She puts rolling skates on his feet and rolls him out towards the frozen pond where he eventually wakes up. Now he has no choice but to teach the impatient girl how to ice skate.

programme.title: The Puzzling Case
programme.desc: The Bear has a new hobby- he collects puzzle pictures with passion. Being frightened that Masha might ruin his plans he builds a house on the tree. He hopes to finish his masterpiece there. Meanwhile Masha is keen on the stories about Sherlock Holmes- the genius detective. She dreams to unravel some story and suddenly she gets to the crime scene.

programme.title: Quartet Plus
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. And he will tell about Bear's childhood and how he was mischievous with the Himalayan bear. Has anything changed since then? We will learn it from the new episode. And most importantly, music will unite everyone!

programme.title: Jack and the Beanstalk
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: The Straw Bull-Calf
programme.desc: There once lived a very old man with his wife. They were very lonely as they had neither children of their own nor grandchildren. Thus, the old man decided to make a bull made of straw to present to his wife. To avoid it falling apart, the man sealed it with resin. The straw bull-calf brought a lot of joy to the old folks, which proves the point of the whole story that each thing can be useful and valuable.

programme.title: Caliph Stork
programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds' language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Go I Know Not Whither
programme.desc: One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Who's Gifted?
programme.desc: Christmas is a time of miracles and gifts. All the inhabitants of the forest prepared performances for Santa Claus, but Masha was the best prepared. Does the good wizard have enough gifts for her?

programme.title: Get Well Soon!
programme.desc: Tired from Masha's endless games, the Bear pre-tends to be sick so the little girl would leave him alone. But the caring girl sets to cure her friend. After a series of failed attempts, she finally man-ages to cure the Bear.

programme.title: Lucky Charms
programme.desc: How to give the Bear his good luck back? A horseshoe, a rabbit's foot, or a knock on wood can do the trick. Masha finds out empirically - if you have a small but faithful friend in a pink scarf, you won't need luck. Everything will turn out in the most successful way. During the experiment, no bear will be harmed. Almost.

programme.title: Tee For Three
programme.desc: How difficult it is to remain calm when two little tombs are raging in the house. Panda and Masha are fooling around for days. To cope with stress, Bear needs a good rest. Will he be able to restore internal forces or two fidgets will not give him peace?

programme.title: Little Cousin
programme.desc: The Bear's little cousin, Panda, comes over to pay a visit. Masha immediately wants to pal up and spend time playing games. A competitive spirit arouses in our heroes as they can't share anything between each other. The Bear quickly figures out that if he leads their rivalry in peaceful direction, they could greatly help him around the house.

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Spring is a time to have fun and play. Snow is melting in the forest and Masha and the penguin are having fun, forgetting about everything. As a result, Masha falls ill. It is not easy to be ill, but it's so nice when there are those who are always ready to take care and entertain. After all, the best medicine is laughter! Masha's guests have found a recipe for a quick recovery - it's circus!

programme.title: The Mystery Guest
programme.desc: Somebody terribly scary has climbed into the house of Penguin and made a terrible mess there! Bear rushes straight down to Antarctica to help the baby, and, of course, Masha tags along with him. Although if we are to face danger, then we must do so together!

programme.title: Home Alone
programme.desc: The miracles always happen on New Year's Eve. Masha finds a magical hat that grants gifts to all the forest dwellers. Masha runs happily around the forest in a clown outfit and brings joy to all the critters. The magical hat has a special gift for the Bear who has not been very lucky on such a dreamlike day.

programme.title: Coming Back Ain't Easy
programme.desc: The Bear hates to say goodbye to Masha and can't stand being apart. Meanwhile, other forest dwellers are chilling in the yard not knowing that this fragile paradise is on the verge of collapse as the Bear receives a long-awaited phone call from Masha…

programme.title: Hide and seek is not for the Weak
programme.desc: Masha wants to play hide and seek. But the Bear has other plans in mind. Knowing that it is impos-sible to go against her wishes, he agrees to play with her. Like many little children Masha “hides” by simply covering her eyes with her hands and the Bear decides to hide himself. He chooses the most incredible places. But nevertheless Masha finds him every time and demands to play with her and once again hides by covering up her eyes.

programme.title: Tracks Of Unknown Animals
programme.desc: First snow falls and the Bear decides to teach Ma-sha how to distinguish the tracks of different ani-mals. Masha is quite far from being a good student and brings the poor Bear almost to madness. But to his great surprise it turns out that some of her answers were not as absurd as they seemed.

programme.title: Call Me Please!
programme.desc: A funny interpretation of an old fable about a boy who called for help and shouted “Wolves!”. The Bear wants to watch a soccer game but first he needs to get rid of the girl. The Bear sends her foe a walk to the forest and gave her a cell phone in order to be safe. As a result Masha annoys him with her calls for any trivial reasons and when she finds herself in real danger, the Bear doesn't answer the phone …

programme.title: Big Hike
programme.desc: When we crave for adventures and new experiences, we take sleeping bags and a tent and go camping. We will admire amazing landscapes, climb a mountain and even look at real volcanoes! Sounds inspiring? But what if you can do all this right now, just by watching this episode? Will the adventures of our heroes inspire you? Let's see!

programme.title: Twinkle, twinkle, little star
programme.desc: Do you think it's hard to get a star from the sky? Nothing is impossible for our heroes! Just build a space ship and take a couple of faithful friends with you, and unforgettable adventures awaits! Bear, Masha and Panda not only visited the moon, but also brought a gift for Lady Bear. Which one? Of course, cosmic!

programme.title: Dance Fever
programme.desc: The Bear's little cousin Panda visits him again. This time their rivalry with Masha comes to dancing fever. While the pig tries to teach them how to dance the Bear builds the stage in the yard. The forest inhabitants will be really astonished by the dancing show tonight!

programme.title: Surprise! Surprise!
programme.desc: The wolves come up with a new idea how to get a stable and nutritious food source… they rob a poultry farm and get a…rooster. Meanwhile Masha and the hare arrange a real egg hunt for all their friends and neighbours! All forest dwellers are very excited to get chocolate eggs except for the wolves who long for some real food… Masha decides to help poor guys and arranges a splendid dinner!

programme.title: Once In A Year
programme.desc: The Bear has his birthday party. All animals come to his place to congratulate him and give some presents. Seeing this Masha decides to prepare for her own birthday so none of the animals wouldn't have a chance to forget about her party and the list of presents.The Bear has his birthday party. All animals come to his place to congratulate him and give some presents. Seeing this Masha decides to prepare for her own birthday so none of the animals wouldn't have a chance to forget about her party and the list of presents.

programme.title: Creepy Tale About Useful Inventions
programme.desc: Here is another spooky story about useful inventions that might nonetheless ruin your life…just imagine…what if there is mega brain who wants to conquer the Earth with some mechanical monsters?! You might think it's a joke, but there are so many gadgets around you, can you guarantee that you are safe? Ok, ok, relax, Masha will find a way out! Oh, yeah!

programme.title: A Myth Full Of Grief And Despair About One Historical Error
programme.desc: Do you know what children are scared the most of at school? What makes them tremble?! Here is a boy called Arkasha who really doesn't like history lessons. The most frightening thing for him was…a history test. He tried his best to prepare for the test, however he fell asleep. When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!

programme.title: Troubled Story About Baba-Yaga
programme.desc: A boy called Pasha was afraid of fairytale villains. He had read so many fairy tales that it got him really scared! Any trouble he faced was shifted to all kind of evil spirits… like Baba-Yaga. Only the courageous firefighters could assure Pasha that Baba-Yaga is not the reason for his troubles at all!

programme.title: Monstrous Tale About Tall And Short
programme.desc: If you think that only little children are afraid of something, than it's not true! Even such tall animal as giraffe has its own fears…For example, he is afraid to lose the sight of his parents and get lost in safari desert. Masha discovers a strange law of nature- even the tallest creatures can be little in front of troubles and even the smallest one can overcome any trouble!

programme.title: Troubled Fable About A Kitten Who Was Lost But Found
programme.desc: Poor kitten could not have stayed on the street if he hadn't met a carrier pigeon who found his lovely owner. So once upon a time he chased a ball of yarn, onto the street, and was so busy playing, he didn't notice that he got lost! He was terrified by strange environment and couldn't find his way home!Like all the other children Masha was afraid of being lost until she heard a story about a kitten. He was just a kitten, but with one particular feature- he couldn't survive outside without being lost. Masha concludes this story by telling us: “If you get lost- don't panic! Remember your address or phone number and don't be shy to call adults for help!”

programme.title: A Ghost Bike Saga Which Makes You Shiver
programme.desc: You think no one could ever be afraid of a bike...Today, you will hear an incredible... and amazing heartbreaking story... about a bicycle! There was one boy called Gosha, who was very upset when he got bicycle for his birthday as he once imagined himself rushing down the street riding that huge two-wheeled scary monster! But in reality it's so simple to ride a bike without any worries...isn't it?

programme.title: Super Scary Story Of A Little Boy Who Was Afraid Of Washing
programme.desc: One boy was so afraid of the water that he stopped washing himself and turned into a piggy! All his buddies ran away from him scared! But in the end he overcame his fear and began to wash his face and hands as he realized that the water can be safe and fun! The boy was very brave and even won a swimming competition!

programme.title: Nightmarish Kids Belief About Christmas Rhymes
programme.desc: What do you think is the scariest holiday? What makes children scared the most? Well, of course, it's... New Year's Eve! Crowds of adults visit you and ask to read poems out loud! Your thoughts are confused, the words get lost and poor children are unable to speak a word! Dear dear parents, please remember this! When the guests are coming please be good and nice The same story happened with one little girl who was so afraid of the guests and Santa Claus that even a chair started to shake under her legs! But suddenly she overcame her fear and remembered one short poem: Children can be patient but they can't resist Then the children learn their best advice!

programme.title: The Wolf and the Fox
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish.

programme.title: The Frog Princess
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.desc: It is a crime drama about the psychological games between a detective with a strong sense of justice but tormented by the crimes he solves, and a genius woman who is insensitive to her own death. ~~ A remake of the UK series "Luther".

programme.title: Har Har Bhakti
programme.desc: Listen to Har Har Bhakti Devotional songs and start your day with praise of gods and goddesses. These songs are composed to inspire reverence, devotion, and connection with the divine.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Janani
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Do Chutki Sindoor
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: Agni Vayu
programme.desc: Agni Vayu Is A Romantic Thriller That Tells The Story Of A Young, Vibrant Dr. Agni And An Ambitious Investment Banker Vayu. As Their Love Blossoms, An Unfortunate Turn Of Events Happens That Throws Them Amid Conspiracy, Misunderstanding, Swindling, And All Sorts Of Paradoxes At Every Turn. They Set Out On A Journey To Unravel The Mystery Surrounding These Events. Can They Both Solve It Together And Will They Disclose Their Feelings To Each Other During The Journey.

programme.title: Armor Monster Ep 02
programme.desc: One day, 12-year-old Zachary once again met the subway "0" which her mother took nine years ago, and the appearance of the subway seems to have some connection with the necklace left by her mother. In order to find her mother, Zachary stepped on the magic subway without hesitation! When the train arrived at the station, Zachary found that he had come to a magical world of elves. He also met the elf Rooney chased by hunters. In order to protect the Rooney, they fled to the underground city. Here, Zachary meets Scarlett, a red haired girl, and Zachary accidently becomes the Rooney and is regarded as a half-face hunter who is under searched with big bonus in the underground city. In order to leave the underground city to find his mother, Zachary has to agree to fight with the old wizard, the King of the underground city. Under Scarlett's training, Zachary grew up fast. In the battle, his determination to protect the Rooney inspired the strength in the necklace and defeated the old wizard. And just when the angry wizard decided to show his real strength, the real half hunter came to the rescue. The real half hunter even had the same necklace. The unexpected encounter of the two necklaces triggered the emergence of spirits and demons which are eager for energy. In order to protect the underground city from being ravage, the half-face hunter left the underground city with Zachary and his friends. They used their tactics to temporarily eliminate the demons in the stone forest near the beast forest, and they entered the beast forest to avoid refuge.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Gimbap is a staple in lunch boxes, but making traditional gimbap rolls can be a hassle. There is an easier and quicker way to make this healthy and delicious dish. Fold the ingredients inside the laver into a square shape instead of rolling it. Pack it with spicy fish cake stir-fry, another popular lunch box recipe.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Looking for recipes to brighten your spring table? Webfoot octopuses are known to taste best and be extra nutritional during their breeding season from March to May. programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: On this Chuseok special, Chef Ryan shares with us how to make kkochijeon, or Korean pan-fried skewers. Meat and vegetables are threaded onto skewers, dipped in flour and beaten egg and pan-fried to make this colorful dish. Check out this quick and fun recipe to make as a family this holiday.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Blood sausage is one of the most beloved foods in Korea. The chewy sausage is stir-fried with spicy sauce to make sundae bokkeum, a popular late-night snack. Try it with sweet and savory corn cheese which cuts the spiciness of the stir-fry. Both are as tasty as they are easy to make, when you are looking to much on something late at night.

programme.title: 1DAY 1KOREA
programme.desc: Looking for recipes that will bring back your lost appetite this spring? programme.title: Le vacanze di Natale
programme.desc: Il preside della scuola media Addison Tate vuole che questo Natale sia speciale, dato che il consiglio ha deciso di chiudere la scuola. Invita la star di Hollywood Dylan Davidson, un ex studente e sua vecchia fiamma, a dirigere la recita scolastica per salvare la scuola.

programme.title: La squadra di Natale
programme.desc: Allie, un'insegnante d'arte disoccupata, deve accettare un lavoro con la Santa Squad per aiutare il ricco vedovo Gordon e le sue due adorabili figlie a riscoprire la magia del Natale.

programme.title: La cura del Natale
programme.desc: Una dottoressa torna a casa per Natale e scopre che suo padre ha deciso di ritirarsi dalla professione. Dopo essersi ricongiunta con il suo fidanzato del liceo, si chiede se debba restare e rilevare lo studio del padre.

programme.title: L'ereditiera del Natale
programme.desc: Loryn, erede di un grande magazzino negli Hamptons, viene messa alla prova dalla nonna nel tentativo di motivarla. Loryn si destreggia tra le attività lavorative nel negozio durante il periodo più intenso dell'anno: il Natale.

programme.title: Sposami a Natale
programme.desc: Durante i preparativi per una cerimonia natalizia molto importante e sofisticata, Madaline Krug, un'organizzatrice di matrimoni, si innamora inaspettatamente del fratello della sposa.

programme.title: Trading Paint
programme.desc: Cam, figlio d'arte di Sam Munroe (John Travolta), una leggenda nel mondo dell'automobilismo, molla la squadra del padre per gareggiare nella squadra rivale, capitanata da Linsky (Michael Madsen), e per dimostrargli di essere finalmente diventato un campione.

programme.title: The Big White
programme.desc: In un piccolo centro dell'Alaska, Paul ha un disperato bisogno di denaro e cerca di incassare l'assicurazione del fratello, sparito da anni, facendo passare un cadavere congelato in cui si è imbattuto per quello del congiunto.

programme.title: Perfect Sense
programme.desc: Michael, uno chef solitario, incontra casualmente Susan, un'epidemiologa, reduce da diverse delusioni amorose. I due si innamorano, ma la dottoressa deve confrontarsi con i primi pazienti colpiti da una pandemia globale.

programme.title: Resistance
programme.desc: 1941. Dopo l'invasione tedesca dell'URSS, la studentessa universitaria Lyudmila Pavlichenko (Yulia Peresild) diventa un cecchino nel 25 ° Divisione.

programme.title: Uno chalet per due
programme.desc: Divorziata amante del Natale prenota un soggiorno in uno chalet con la madre e la figlia. Tuttavia, lo stesso chalet viene prenotato da uno scrittore single che odia il Natale. Insieme scopriranno la magia del Natale e della famiglia.

programme.title: Per sempre Natale
programme.desc: Quando un uomo affascinante arriva in città e mette in discussione le sue tradizionali idee sulle feste, Carol deve imparare a scendere a compromessi, anche se questo significa vivere una storia d'amore inaspettata.

programme.title: Un matrimonio per Natale
programme.desc: Quando Haley torna nella sua casa per aiutare la sorella a pianificare il matrimonio perfetto, incontra la sua cotta e si ritrova a combattere tra la sua nuova vita e l'amore della sua vita.

programme.title: Come salvare il Natale
programme.desc: Zoey decide di affittare un camioncino e di partecipare per gioco a una gara di un reality in TV. Tra lei e l'affascinante fondatore di una catena di fast food sembra accendersi la passione, ma quando Zoey scopre che lui è un giudice del concorso, le cose precipitano rapidamente.

programme.title: A Christmas Hero
programme.desc: Il vigile del fuoco Jenny si innamora di Tom, ma la sua ex moglie e autrice di bestseller Mary pretende una riconciliazione o terrà lontana la figlia a Natale.

programme.title: L'uomo dal pennello d'oro
programme.desc: Commedia con la bellissima Edwige Fenech! Arcibaldo, giovane stravagante, passa gran parte del suo tempo insieme ad un gruppo di amici molto movimentato. Nel tempo libero, imbratta tele gettandovi i colori per mezzo delle parti anatomiche delle sue amichette. Convinto che il suo talento non possa passare inosservato, organizza una mostra alla quale si presenta nudo. L'evento gli cambierà la vita!

programme.title: La collegiale
programme.desc: Daniela, dopo essere stata per alcuni anni in collegio, decide di tornare in famiglia. Scopre così che suo padre si preoccupa esclusivamente del denaro e sua madre pensa solo a un altro uomo. La ragazza all'inizio è scandalizzata dai nuovi equilibri all'interno della sua famiglia ma, successivamente, attua un piano per risolvere la situazione.

programme.title: Quello strano desiderio
programme.desc: Due alieni del pianeta "Alpha 4" vincono un viaggio premio sulla Terra. Arrivano a Bari, dove entrano nei corpi di due poveri ragionieri.

programme.title: Gli amici di Nick Hezard
programme.desc: Per vendicare la morte del suo amico, un giovane lestofante in Svizzera predispone un'ingegnosa truffa ai danni del principale responsabile, un affarista americano. Gli fa credere di esser stato coinvolto in un omicidio e fa in modo di sottrargli una grossa quantità di denaro. L'attuazione del piano, però, non sarà affatto semplice.

programme.title: Totò, Peppino e le fanatiche
programme.desc: Irresistibile commedia interpretata dal grande Totò, simbolo della comicità, e dal divertentissimo Peppino De Filippo. Il Cavalier Vignarello e il ragionier Caprioli, ricoverati in una clinica per malattie mentali, si rivolgono al Direttore sostenendo di trovarsi lì per equivoco e a causa delle manie dei rispettivi familiari. Riescono a convincerlo e accade qualcosa di incredibile.

programme.title: La donna della domenica
programme.desc: Un Classico del cinema italiano, diretto da Luigi Comencini e interpretato da Marcello Mastroianni e Jean-louis Trintignant. A Torino viene misteriosamente ucciso un architetto. Le indagini portano il commissario Santamaria a indirizzare i suoi sospetti su alcuni esponenti dell'alta società, e in particolare su Anna, moglie di un grosso industriale, e sul suo confidente, un dottore.

programme.title: Amore mio aiutami
programme.desc: Giovanni e Raffaella sono una coppia affiatata da dieci anni. La relazione va però in crisi quando Raffaella s'innamora di Valerio, un piacente quarantenne. Raffaella è quindi invaghita della nuova fiamma ma, confidando nella comprensione del marito che si vanta da sempre del suo essere moderno, aperto e razionale, chiede il suo aiuto.

programme.title: Detenuto in attesa di giudizio
programme.desc: Giuseppe è un geometra emigrato in Svezia, dove ha fatto fortuna con la sua piccola impresa edile. Torna in Italia per far conoscere il suo Paese alla moglie Ingrid, ma alla frontiera viene inspiegabilmente fermato e quindi arrestato. In carcere, scopre di essere accusato di un delitto gravissimo. Una delle rare interpretazioni drammatiche del magistrale Alberto Sordi.

programme.title: Una storia moderna: l'ape regina
programme.desc: Prima opera italiana del regista Marco Ferreri con i celebri Ugo Tognazzi, Walter Giller e Marina Vlady. Il quarantenne Alfonso riesce finalmente a sposare Regina, vergine, educata, bella e molto cattolica. Quando Regina inizia a mettergli pressione perché vuole avere un bambino, l'uomo si ammala e, raggiunto l'obiettivo, Regina inizierà a trascurarlo fino a causare un drammatico evento.

programme.title: Il Magnifico Cornuto
programme.desc: Meravigliosa commedia con Claudia Cardinale, Ugo Tognazzi e Gian Maria Volontè. Andrea Artusi è geloso e sospettoso a tal punto che sua moglie Maria Grazia deve inventarsi il nome di un finto amante. In questo modo il marito si sente soddisfatto ma la donna comincia ad abituarsi all'idea di averne uno. Un grande classico del cinema italiano.

programme.title: Una giornata particolare
programme.desc: 6 maggio 1938. La Roma fascista è in festa per l`arrivo del Fuhrer in visita dal Duce. In un angolo di Roma più lontano dai fasti, in un edificio popolare, Antonietta, casalinga madre di sei figli, cresciuta nel culto del Duce, incontra casualmente per la prima volta il suo vicino di casa, Gabriele, ex annunciatore radiofonico omosessuale e prossimo al confino. Dopo la diffidenza iniziale, il loro rapporto si trasforma in affetto e comprensione...

programme.title: I fuorilegge del matrimonio
programme.desc: Sei storie di matrimoni impossibili: tra leggi, ricatti e assurdità burocratiche, uomini e donne si ritrovano intrappolati in legami che non possono sciogliere. Tra manicomio, carcere, divorzio estero e conventi, l'amore si scontra con l'inflessibilità delle istituzioni, generando drammi, equivoci e amara ironia.

programme.title: Rappresaglia
programme.desc: Roma 23 Marzo 1944. Le truppe tedesche tengono la città sotto il loro controllo. In seguito ad un attentato contro una compagnia delle SS compiuto in via Rasella, il generale Maelzer informa i suoi capi a Berlino che, decisi ad abrogare qualunque soglia di tolleranza, ordinano una veloce rappresaglia, pretendendo l`esecuzione di dieci italiani per ogni tedesco ucciso. Sarà il tenente colonnello Herbert Kapller a gestire l`intervento e a compilare la lista dei sacrificati, nonostante il suo aperto dissenso.

programme.title: Allonsanfan
programme.desc: 1816. Nell`Europa della Restaurazione, Fulvio Imbriani, un prigioniero politico aristocratico, ex giacobino ed ex ufficiale napoleonico, esce dal carcere e fa ritorno alla proprietà di famiglia. I suoi ex compagni di lotta fanno di tutto per coinvolgerlo nuovamente in azioni rivoluzionarie, ma lui è riluttante e sfiduciato. Finché si butta a capofitto in una rovinosa spedizione al Sud...

programme.title: The Constant Gardener
programme.desc: Quando sua moglie Tessa viene trovata morta in Kenya, il diplomatico Justin Quayle inizia a indagare, scoprendo una rete di corruzione e segreti pericolosi. Tra intrighi politici e complotti farmaceutici, la sua ricerca della verità metterà a rischio la sua stessa vita.

programme.title: Fuggiamo insieme
programme.desc: Quando una ragazza appena sposata scopre che suo marito è un nazista, lo lascia e scappa con un giornalista radiofonico che si innamora di lei mentre la segue alla ricerca di una storia su suo marito.

programme.title: Closing the Ring
programme.desc: Teddy Gordon, agricoltore, viene chiamato a combattere tra le fila dell'esercito americano durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale. Prima di partire per il fronte convola a nozze con l'amata Ethel Ann e al contempo fa un'insolita richiesta al suo migliore amico Chuck: se dovesse morire sul campo, lui dovrà sposare la sua vedova.

programme.title: Foxcatcher
programme.desc: Medaglie d'oro olimpiche nel 1984, Mark e Dave Schultz si preparano a difendere il titolo ai prossimi Giochi di Seoul. Tuttavia, Mark viene escluso dal gruppo degli atleti selezionati, proprio come suo fratello maggiore, e si sforza di allenarsi da solo. Mark ritrova la speranza quando il filantropo e miliardario John du Pont, intenzionato a mettere insieme la migliore squadra di wrestling in tutto il mondogli gli chiede di aderire al marchio wrestling di un nuovo club. Ma le illusioni paranoiche di Du Pont e la sua irrazionale volontà di garantire la vittoria degli Stati Uniti all'estero avranno la precedenza sulla sua generosità e gentilezza. Il film è tratto da una storia vera: nel 1996 John du Pont, affetto da schizofrenia paranoide, uccise l'amico David Schultz, campione olimpico di wrestling.

programme.title: UN REGALO SPECIALE
programme.desc: Quando le sorelle Cara e Amy stringono un patto per trovare l'anima gemella entro il prossimo Natale, non si aspettano di essere così fortunate. Un anno dopo, il matrimonio di Amy si avvicina e Cara trova la sua anima gemella, ma la perde rapidamente. Il suo desiderio si avvererà?

programme.title: IO E MR. CHRISTMAS
programme.desc: Zoe Deans, esperta di pubbliche relazioni, lascia la grande agenzia per aprire la propria attività, ma ha bisogno di un cliente importante per farsi notare. Su suggerimento del suo migliore amico Nic, decide di rappresentare un concorrente al concorso natalizio Mr. Christmas, trasformando l'evento in una grande occasione pubblicitaria. Convinta che creare una piccola celebrità natalizia sia facile grazie alla sua esperienza, Zoe si lancia con entusiasmo in questa sfida non convenzionale — decisa a trovare “il ragazzo giusto” da trasformare in star.

programme.title: L'EREDITIERA DEL NATALE
programme.desc: Loryn, erede di un grande magazzino negli Hamptons, viene messa alla prova dalla nonna nel tentativo di motivarla. Loryn si destreggia tra le attività lavorative nel negozio durante il periodo più intenso dell'anno: il Natale.

programme.title: LE 12 SFIDE PER NATALE
programme.desc: La tranquilla stagione festiva di un'insegnante subisce una scossa quando accetta la sfida delle 12 prove di Natale lanciata dalla sorella, mentre si affretta a preparare la sua città per un programma di scambio natalizio con un affabile e supponente insegnante di francese.

programme.title: UN TOCCO DI CREATIVITÀ A NATALE
programme.desc: Harper, un'aspirante illustratrice, sta collaborando con Caleb, un autore di libri molto esigente. Quando lui insiste affinché lei lavori durante il periodo natalizio in una pittoresca cittadina, lei deve sfruttare i festeggiamenti natalizi della città per aiutarlo a superare il suo blocco dello scrittore.

programme.title: Archangel
programme.desc: Mosca. Lo storico Luke Kelso incontra un ex soldato della milizia sovietica che gli comunica l'esistenza di un segreto di Stalin custodito nella città russa di Arcangelo. Quando il militare viene misteriosamente assassinato, Kelso inizia a indagare.

programme.title: Ironclad
programme.desc: Nell'Inghilterra del 1215 infuria la violenta guerra tra i baroni e il re Giovanni. I baroni difendono con tutti i mezzi a disposizione i castelli che hanno occupato, contando anche sull'aiuto delle truppe francesi.

programme.title: Bad blood
programme.desc: Hannah è bionda, carina e incastrata in una vita buia e sporca, fatta di droghe, spaccio e illegalità in tutte le sue declinazioni. Sulle sue spalle, grava la responsabilità dell'intera famiglia, coinvolta in affari illeciti e amori impossibili.

programme.title: Senza santi in paradiso
programme.desc: Bob e Ruth sono una coppia di fuorilegge che vengono catturati dopo una sparatoria. Bob si prende la colpa dell'accaduto e Ruth viene rilasciata e porta avanti una gravidanza. Dopo quattro anni Bob evade per conoscere la figlia mai vista finora.

programme.title: Hansel e Gretel e La Strega Della Foresta Nera
programme.desc: I fratelli Hansel e Gretel, abbandonati nel bosco, finiscono nella casa di una strega che intende cucinarli. I due riescono non solo a fuggire ma anche ad uccidere la strega. Quest'episodio trasforma la loro vita, che da quel momento in poi i due decidono di dedicare alla lotta alle streghe.

programme.title: Crucifixion
programme.desc: Padre Dumitru e alcune suore compiono un violento esorcismo su suor Adelina, che si crede posseduta da un demone. A seguito della morte di quest'ultima, i suoi aguzzini vengono arrestati con l'accusa di omicidio. Nella capitale giunge Nicole, giornalista newyorchese, che vuole indagare sul caso.

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: Una ragazza cieca riceve un trapianto di cornea per tornare a vedere. Tuttavia, si accorge presto di poter vedere tutto... anche fantasmi inquietanti.

programme.title: Santa Sangre
programme.desc: Fuggito da un manicomio, Fenix torna nel mondo guidato dalla madre mutilata. L'inizio di un'odissea visionaria tra follia, sangue e illusioni.

programme.title: Nottetempo
programme.desc: Un incidente, tre vite spezzate, un viaggio tra verità nascoste e incontri inaspettati. Un noir sentimentale che scava nell'anima.

programme.title: Tre voci per Natale
programme.desc: Il teatro dell'opera sta chiudendo e, per salvarlo, la figlia del proprietario riunisce il gruppo En Vogue per esibirsi in uno spettacolo natalizio nel luogo che li ha lanciati.

programme.title: Un Natale da salvare
programme.desc: Gli animali della fattoria di Woodsley aiutano Oliver e la sua sorellina June a mettere in scena il classico racconto di 'Un canto di Natale' per shockare il loro papà e fargli abbracciare lo spirito delle feste.

programme.title: Una dolce occasione
programme.desc: La mamma di Cate sta organizzando appuntamenti per la sua figlia direttrice. Quando incontra Gabe una settimana prima di Natale, pensa che sia un appuntamento, ma in realtà è un consulente per la ristrutturazione aziendale della sua azienda di bastoncini di zucchero. Anche lui è single.

programme.title: 12 cani sotto l'albero
programme.desc: Jack, un adolescente in difficoltà, viene assegnato a un rifugio per animali durante le vacanze di Natale come parte del suo servizio alla comunità. L'esperienza lo cambierà in meglio?

programme.title: Destinazione Natale
programme.desc: Emma Warner, come SVP di un'azienda di giocattoli, trascorre 12 mesi all'anno concentrandosi sul Natale, senza lasciare tempo per gli appuntamenti. Quest'anno, pianifica un viaggio in un resort tropicale per single, ma un errore di prenotazione la porta in una città ossessionata dal Natale.

programme.title: Il ritorno dei morti viventi 3
programme.desc: Ne Il ritorno dei morti viventi III, la Trioxina, un composto chimico, trasforma la gente in zombie magia-cervelli. Con il dilagare dell'infezione, il governo cerca di controllare questi assassini cannibali e inarrestabili con un progetto segreto.

programme.title: Soar into the sun
programme.desc: Un pilota sudcoreano della Air Force, Tae Hun, si ritrova trasferito in una unità di combattimento aerea dopo una arrogante e pericolosa quanto non pianificata dimostrazione di volo. Il primo giorno del suo trasferimento al F15K, incontra Cheol Hee, Top Gun dell'unità.

programme.title: Cirano di Bergerac
programme.desc: Il carismatico poeta-spadaccino aiuta un altro a corteggiare la donna che ama in questa versione semplice dell'opera.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite, instillando l'amore, la sensibilità e la paura in chi ne viene colpito. In tale contesto, i giovani Nia e Silas vivranno sulla loro pelle i dilemmi generati da una relazione proibita.

programme.title: Toy boy
programme.desc: Nikki è un giovane e incallito playboy che si fa mantenere da Samantha, ricca e matura avvocatessa. Mette in atto precise strategie per attrarre a sé donne più o meno giovani per puro piacere. Ma cosa succede se arriva l'amore?

programme.title: Chiedi Alla Polvere
programme.desc: Nella Los Angeles della Grande Depressione si incontrano lo scrittore italo-americano Arturo e la cameriera messicana Camilla. Lui sogna di scrivere il romanzo della vita, lei di sposare un uomo ricco e cambiare le sue umili sorti.

programme.title: Un amore a gonfie vele
programme.desc: Lorelei, una giovane donna in carriera, assume Rob, un affascinante velista. Il suo compito è rimettere in sesto e in grado di navigare una vecchia barca a vela, ereditata da un parente lontano.

programme.title: Un amore di pasticceri
programme.desc: Jessie è una panettiera che ama il suo negozio più di ogni altra cosa al mondo. Quando una ristrutturazione minaccia di costringerla ad andarsene, deve salvare la sua panetteria, mentre si destreggia con una storia d'amore in piena fioritura.

programme.title: Amore in safari
programme.desc: Una web designer statunitense eredita una riserva naturale privata in Sud Africa. Un ranger dai modi schietti la guida in un safari nella speranza che si innamori di quella terra, degli animali e di lui.

programme.title: Trekking con sorpresa
programme.desc: Un nonno riunisce la famiglia a Maiorca per annunciare il suo matrimonio e ristabilire armonia.

programme.title: Il fiume della vita
programme.desc: Charlotte è una microbiologa con la responsabilità della crescita dei suoi due nipoti, essendo la sorella morta per un incidente.

programme.title: Il miracolo della Carinzia
programme.desc: Quando la piccola Kathi viene ricoverata in ospedale, è clinicamente morta. Il chirurgo Markus la salverà?

programme.title: Viaggio sul Kilimangiaro
programme.desc: Un padre, una figlia e tre vite spezzate si rigenerano lungo l'ascesa al Kilimangiaro.

programme.title: Two Lovers
programme.desc: New York. Leonard non sa se seguire il proprio destino e sposare Sandra, la donna che i suoi genitori hanno scelto per lui, o ribellarsi e ascoltare i sentimenti che prova per la sua nuova vicina di casa, la bella e volubile Michelle, di cui si è perdutamente innamorato. Combattuto tra ragione e istinto, dovrà compiere la scelta più difficile…

programme.title: Savage Grace
programme.desc: Barbara Daly, una donna dalla vita apparentemente perfetta, ha sposato Brooks Baekeland, l'erede dell'impero della bachelite. La nascita di Tony, il loro primo e unico figlio, rompe il delicato equilibrio di questa coppia così stranamente assortita. Agli occhi di suo padre, Tony non è altro che l'ennesimo insuccesso. Man mano che cresce, infatti, il ragazzo si attacca sempre più alla figura della madre. Sta per consumarsi una terribile tragedia.

programme.title: I nostri giorni dopo
programme.desc: L'Aquila era, ed è ancora, una città colpita al cuore, che vive in un tempo sospeso, dove gli abitanti, con grande forza e dignità, lottano ogni giorno per riconquistare i luoghi della loro vita e ricostruirsi un futuro. Un esempio universale delle difficoltà e dei conflitti che emergono dopo un disastro che cancella tutte le certezze, ma anche della capacità e del coraggio di reagire e di rimettersi in gioco.

programme.title: A passo due
programme.desc: 31 Dicembre. Ennio è un ex disegnatore professionista che non ha ancora superato la morte della moglie, rifugiandosi in una quotidianità sociopatica e illusoria. Ennio si prepara a raggiungere la moglie per la mezzanotte dell'ultimo giorno dell'anno.

programme.title: Milk
programme.desc: Attivista del movimento dei diritti degli omosessuali. Amico. Amante. Unificatore. Politico. Combattente. Icona. Ispiratore. Eroe. La sua vita ha cambiato la storia, e il suo coraggio ha cambiato la vita di tante persone.

programme.title: Lo Stravagante mondo di Greenberg
programme.desc: Quando la famiglia Greenberg parte per una vacanza in Vietnam di sei settimane, la cura della loro villa di Los Angeles e del cane Mahler viene affidata alla giovane Florence Marr, la loro assistente personale. Durante quel periodo, Florence fa la conoscenza di un eccentrico ospite, lo zio Roger, quarantenne irresponsabile che da tempo si è trasferito a New York e ha alle spalle una degenza per cure psichiatriche.

programme.title: Lola + Jeremy
programme.desc: Jeremy, 27 anni, è un graphic designer e con il suo amico Mathias gestisce l'agenzia Cercasi alibi disperatamente per creare finti alibi tramite fatture, ricevute e scontrini per i fidanzati fedifraghi. Lola, 25 anni, lavora in una fumetteria ed è appassionata di supereroi e dei film di Michel Gondry, in particolare di “Se mi lasci ti cancello” che non si stanca mai di rivedere. Lola e Jeremy decidono di riprendere ogni momento della loro storia d'amore, per creare una sorta di video diario giornaliero da riguardare da lì a dieci anni. Lola, troppo curiosa, non resiste e si mette a guardarli subito da sola. Video dopo video, ne trova uno che non avrebbe dovuto vedere: Jeremy e i suoi amici stanno parlando proprio di lei, prim'ancora di conoscersi, e del progetto di Jeremy di girare un video diario da mostrare al padre in fin di vita in ospedale. Lola, delusa e ferita lascia Jeremy il cui solo scopo sarà, da quel momento, cercare di riconquistarla. Disperato pensa di mettere insieme un gruppo di strampalati supereroi, che rapiscono personaggi famosi. Il riscatto? Lola. E così le vie della periferia parigina si animano di una scalcagnata banda di eroi da fumetto, impegnati a organizzare impossibili e grotteschi rapimenti. Nel film tre piccoli camei, quello del regista Michel Gondry nella parte di se stesso, il batterista Manu Katché, per anni al fianco di Peter Gabriel e il rapper Youssoupha.

programme.title: We are the best!
programme.desc: Stoccolma, 1982. Bobo, tredici anni, affronta con una certa intraprendenza la propria adolescenza inquieta. La sua amica del cuore è la coetanea Klara, con la quale condivide una fiera marginalità rispetto agli altri compagni di scuola. Bobo suona il basso e Klara la batteria, amano il punk, vorrebbero una band tutta loro. La svolta avviene quando conoscono Hedvig, bravissima a suonare la chitarra (classica). La convertono al rock e a tagliarsi i capelli suscitando l'ira della madre e finalmente, suonano. Il loro motto è: “Il punk non è mai morto”. Sono inseparabili, finché incontrano un ragazzo già affermato nell'emergente giro “rockettaro” della città, e del quale si invaghiscono sia Bobo che Klara.

programme.title: A Royal Weekend
programme.desc: La storia della relazione d'amore tra il Presidente Roosevelt e sua cugina Margaret Stuckley che si consuma nel weekend del giugno 1939 quando il Re e la Regina d'Inghilterra fanno visita al Presidente presso il suo cottage di New York.

programme.title: Il nostro paradiso
programme.desc: Un anziano signore rilascia un'intervista ad una reporter catanese in cui racconta la storia, mai conosciuta, di una band musicale siciliana attiva dal 1963 al 1979, poi misteriosamente scomparsa e di cui nessuno ha ricordo. Ripercorrerà, attraverso una lunga lista di canzoni inedite, la vita dei vari componenti del gruppo e il legame che con essi egli aveva.

programme.title: Amore estremo
programme.desc: Il premio Oscar® Ben Affleck è Gigli, un criminale da quattro soldi al quale viene affidato un compito impegnativo: salvare un boss della malavita dalla prigione. Per far ciò dovrà rapire il fratello minorato di un potente procuratore distrettuale. Ma quando Ricki (Jennifer Lopez), la bella e disinvolta assassina, è mandata ad aiutare Gigli, questi se ne innamora. Dal lasciare che i sentimenti si mettano in mezzo al lavoro, però, non viene fuori mai niente di buono. Per nessuno.

programme.title: Bad Teacher: Una Cattiva Maestra
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata lasciata dal ricco fidanzato, Elisabeth, sboccata insegnante delle medie con metodi poco ortodossi, ingaggerà un aspro duello con una collega per la conquista del professore modello della scuola, un supplente rampollo di una famiglia benestante.

programme.title: La cosa più dolce
programme.desc: Quando si tratta di uscire con un uomo, Christina Walters (Cameron Diaz) ha una regola d'oro: evitare l'uomo giusto e concentrarsi su quello del momento. Questo, fino a quando non conosce inaspettatamente Peter (Thomas Jane), che il giorno dopo scompare. Lei sa solo che deve presenziare a un matrimonio, ma non sa che è il suo. Insieme alla migliore amica Courtney (Christina Applegate), Christina decide di infrangere le regole e andarlo a cercare, imbattendosi in varie e divertenti disavventure durante il viaggio. Connubio di un film on the road, umorismo e ricerca dell'uomo perfetto, The Sweetest Thing è una commedia romantica piuttosto amara, una svolta nuova sulla ricerca dell'amore.

programme.title: Amore estremo
programme.desc: Il premio Oscar® Ben Affleck è Gigli, un criminale da quattro soldi al quale viene affidato un compito impegnativo: salvare un boss della malavita dalla prigione.
